excerpt.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
excerpt.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.
